description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Spectro DMG. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
Press Normal Attack or Jump to perform Basic Attack Stage 2 and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Dissection when the input is Normal Attack.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Resection when the input is Jump. He also inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s and reduces DMG taken by 15% for 1s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.
Pada Tahap 3, melontarkan bilah berputar yang menghilang saat Luuk Herssen melancarkan skill lain yang dapat memberikan damage atau meninggalkan lapangan.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melompat ke udara, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun di udara yang memberikan Spectro DMG. Tahap 4 adalah Plunging Attack dengan biaya STA.
Tekan Normal Attack atau Jump untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2 dan 3 di udara.
Luuk Herssen menyerang dengan Scythe: Dissection saat input adalah Normal Attack.
Luuk Herssen menyerang dengan Scythe: Resection saat input adalah Jump. Ia juga memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target yang terkena selama 25 dtk dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima sebesar 15% selama 1 dtk.
Saat menjadi Resonator aktif dan berada di udara, siklus skill ini tidak akan di-reset.
Saat di udara, tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan biaya STA.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil di darat untuk memberikan Spectro DMG. Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.
Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil di udara untuk melesat ke arah target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en:
Golden Reflux

Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Golden Reflux has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution

Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack Stage 3 replaces Resonance Skill with Aureole of Execution, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Aureole of Execution has 3 forms, including Aureole of Execution: Ring, Aureole of Execution: Breach, and Aureole of Execution: Glare.
Casting any form of Aureole of Execution grants 1 stacks of Endnotes on the Endgame and switches Aureole of Execution to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of Aureole of Execution and Resonance Skill is reset to Golden Reflux.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution: Ring

Deal Spectro DMG, and reset the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Breach

Spin and dash forward, dealing Spectro DMG to enemies along the path and resetting the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an Ichor Blade.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Glare

Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing Spectro DMG and forming an Ichor Deposit on the ground.

Basic Attack - Golden Impale

Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Ichor Deposit

Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after 5s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Endnotes on the Endgame

Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Casting Rewritten in Winter's Margins or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.
description.id:
Golden Reflux

Melesat ke arah target dan memberikan Spectro DMG. Memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target yang terkena selama 25 dtk.
Golden Reflux memiliki 2 charge.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Aureole of Execution

Melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4 atau Mid-air Attack Tahap 3 mengganti Resonance Skill dengan Aureole of Execution, yang memberikan Basic Attack DMG dan memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target yang terkena selama 25 dtk.
Aureole of Execution memiliki 3 bentuk, yaitu Aureole of Execution: Ring, Aureole of Execution: Breach, dan Aureole of Execution: Glare.
Melancarkan bentuk Aureole of Execution mana pun memberikan 1 stack Endnotes on the Endgame dan mengganti Aureole of Execution ke bentuk berikutnya secara berurutan.
Berganti ke Resonator lain me-reset siklus Aureole of Execution dan Resonance Skill kembali menjadi Golden Reflux.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Aureole of Execution: Ring

Memberikan Spectro DMG, dan me-reset siklus Mid-air Attack ke Tahap 1.
Normal Attack berikutnya memicu Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale tidak lagi tersedia jika Dodge Counter dilancarkan di udara atau Luuk Herssen diganti keluar selama durasinya.

Aureole of Execution: Breach

Berputar dan melesat ke depan, memberikan Spectro DMG kepada musuh di sepanjang jalur dan me-reset siklus Mid-air Attack ke Tahap 1. Lalu, melontarkan Ichor Blade.
Normal Attack berikutnya memicu Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale tidak lagi tersedia jika Dodge Counter dilancarkan di udara atau Luuk Herssen diganti keluar selama durasinya.

Aureole of Execution: Glare

Melontarkan Solid-State Ichor, memberikan Spectro DMG dan membentuk Ichor Deposit di tanah.

Basic Attack - Golden Impale

Melesat ke arah target dan memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Ichor Deposit

Ichor Deposit meledak otomatis setelah 5 dtk, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Endnotes on the Endgame

Meningkatkan pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins sebesar 25%, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Melancarkan Rewritten in Winter's Margins atau berganti ke Resonator lain menghapus seluruh stack.

description.en:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by Tune Strain - Interfered:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's Tune Strain - Interfered stacks.

Perpetuating Daytime

- When Resonators in the team casts Tune Break, if the target is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting, Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, up to the target's current Tune Strain - Interfered stack cap. Cooldown: 1s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to 2 times.
description.id:
Saat Resonator dalam tim memberikan damage langsung dan mengalahkan target, jika target terkena Tune Strain - Interfered:
- Jika Luuk Herssen tidak memiliki Perpetuating Daytime, mendapat stack Perpetuating Daytime sebanyak stack Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Jika Luuk Herssen sudah memiliki Perpetuating Daytime, dan stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target melebihi stack Perpetuating Daytime saat ini, stack Perpetuating Daytime ditingkatkan hingga sama dengan stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target.

Perpetuating Daytime

- Saat Resonator dalam tim melancarkan Tune Break, jika target terkena Tune Strain - Shifting, Luuk Herssen kehilangan seluruh stack Perpetuating Daytime, lalu memberikan stack Tune Strain - Interfered yang sama pada target, hingga batas stack Tune Strain - Interfered target saat ini. Cooldown: 1 dtk.
Luuk Herssen kehilangan seluruh stack Perpetuating Daytime dan tidak dapat memperoleh stack baru saat tumbang.
- Perpetuating Daytime bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.

description.en:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by Tune Strain - Interfered, every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has Amplifies this instance of damage by 5%, up to 30%.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the enemies or deals Tune Break DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by 25% for 20s.
description.id:
Saat skill Luuk Herssen memberikan damage langsung kepada target yang terkena Tune Strain - Interfered, setiap 10 poin Tune Break Boost yang dimilikinya meng-Amplify damage tersebut sebesar 5%, hingga 30%.
Setelah Resonator dalam tim di sekitar memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada musuh atau memberikan Tune Break DMG, ATK Luuk Herssen meningkat sebesar 25% selama 20 dtk.

description.en:
Deal Spectro DMG. Hurl out an Ichor Blade and inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.

description.id:
Memberikan Spectro DMG. Melontarkan Ichor Blade dan memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target.

description.en:
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker

When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare is hurled out, press Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
Slam down from the air to detonate the Ichor Deposit, dealing Spectro DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker is no longer available when Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

Aureate Judge

With full Ichor Flow, enter the Aureate Judge state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- Ichor Flow does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution increase by 110%.
- Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit DMG by 110%.
- 100 points of Ichor Flow is consumed each time Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution is cast.
- Aureate Judge ends when Ichor Flow depletes.

Golden Rule

When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen 200 points of Ichor Flow and 12 points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after 24s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep

Luuk Herssen gains 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at 1 stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by 60% and gain immunity to interruptions for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Radiant Reave

When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an Ichor Blade.
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, press Dodge before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than 3s, the trigger count is reset.

Ichor Blade

Deal fixed Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one Ichor Blade can exist at a time. It cannot trigger Counterattack.
Ichor Blade cannot be launched without a nearby target.
Ichor Blade disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

Ichor Flow

Luuk Herssen holds up to 300 points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill Golden Reflux, Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Basic Attack - Golden Impale, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points of Ichor Flow.
description.id:
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker

Saat Solid-State Ichor dari Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare dilontarkan, tekan Normal Attack di udara untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
Menghantam turun dari udara untuk meledakkan Ichor Deposit, memberikan Spectro DMG (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG) dan memulihkan seluruh STA.
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker tidak lagi tersedia saat Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins dilancarkan atau Luuk Herssen diganti keluar dari lapangan.

Aureate Judge

Dengan Ichor Flow penuh, memasuki state Aureate Judge. Dalam state ini, Luuk Herssen mendapat efek berikut:
- Ichor Flow tidak pulih. Pengali DMG semua bentuk Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution meningkat sebesar 110%.
- Melancarkan Aureole of Execution: Glare meningkatkan pengali DMG Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker berikutnya dan DMG Ichor Deposit sebesar 110%.
- 100 poin Ichor Flow dikonsumsi setiap kali Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution dilancarkan.
- Aureate Judge berakhir saat Ichor Flow habis.

Golden Rule

Saat Luuk Herssen berada dalam tim, semua Resonator lain dalam tim mendapat Golden Rule. Saat Resonator dengan Golden Rule melancarkan Outro Skill dan Resonator yang masuk adalah Luuk Herssen, seluruh Golden Rule pada Resonator dalam tim dihapus dan Luuk Herssen mendapat 200 poin Ichor Flow dan 12 poin Concerto Energy. Resonator dalam tim mendapat Golden Rule lagi setelah 24 dtk. Efek ini tidak berlaku di Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep

Luuk Herssen mendapat 1 stack Dawnlit Keep saat berada di luar pertempuran lebih dari 4 dtk atau melancarkan Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn.
Dawnlit Keep dibatasi hingga 1 stack. Saat menerima damage dari musuh, mengonsumsi 1 stack Dawnlit Keep untuk mengurangi DMG yang diterima sebesar 60% dan kebal terhadap interupsi selama 1 dtk. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali per detik.

Radiant Reave

Saat Luuk Herssen melakukan Dodge di udara, ia sesaat tetap melayang dan melontarkan Ichor Blade.
Luuk Herssen terus mengonsumsi STA selama melayang.
Jika Luuk Herssen terlempar ke udara, tekan Dodge sebelum mendarat untuk memicu efek ini, hingga 3 kali. Saat ia berada di tanah atau diganti keluar lebih dari 3 dtk, jumlah pemicu di-reset.

Ichor Blade

Memberikan Spectro DMG tetap, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG yang tidak dipengaruhi DMG Bonus apa pun.
Hanya satu Ichor Blade yang dapat ada pada satu waktu. Tidak dapat memicu Counterattack.
Ichor Blade tidak dapat dilontarkan tanpa target di sekitar.
Ichor Blade menghilang saat Luuk Herssen melancarkan skill lain yang memberikan damage atau meninggalkan lapangan.

Ichor Flow

Luuk Herssen dapat menyimpan hingga 300 poin Ichor Flow.
Normal Attack, Resonance Skill Golden Reflux, Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Basic Attack - Golden Impale, dan Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker memulihkan Ichor Flow saat mengenai target.
Melancarkan Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn memulihkan 100 poin Ichor Flow.

description.en:
Luuk Herssen can inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on targets.
Luuk Herssen can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
When responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Luuk Herssen can cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id:
Luuk Herssen dapat memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target.
Luuk Herssen dapat merespons Tune Strain - Interfered.
Saat merespons Tune Strain - Interfered: Untuk setiap stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target, setiap poin Tune Break Boost Luuk Herssen meningkatkan total DMG-nya terhadap target sebesar 0,12%. Selama Luuk Herssen berada dalam tim, batas stack maksimum Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkat sebanyak 1.
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Luuk Herssen dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

Inherent Skill Pulses Under the Snow is enhanced:
Perpetuating Daytime now stacks up to 4 times.
description.id:
Pengali DMG semua bentuk Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution meningkat sebesar 136% dalam state Aureate Judge. Melancarkan Aureole of Execution: Glare meningkatkan pengali DMG Mid-Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker berikutnya dan Ichor Deposit sebesar 136%.
Inherent Skill Pulses Under the Snow ditingkatkan:
Perpetuating Daytime kini bertumpuk hingga 4 kali.

description.id: Setelah Resonator dalam tim memberikan Tune Break DMG, seluruh Resonator dalam tim memberikan 20% DMG lebih banyak selama 20 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

description.en:
Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn and Outro Skill Bow to the Last Light gain 80% DMG Bonus.

description.id:
Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn dan Outro Skill Bow to the Last Light mendapat 80% DMG Bonus.
Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Golden Reflux meningkat sebesar 50% dan Cooldown berkurang 2 dtk, serta mendapat 1 charge tambahan.

description.en:
When nearby Resonators in the team deal Tune Break DMG, all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Ichor Deposit, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker deal 30% more DMG to the target for 25s.
Each stack of Endnotes on the Endgame additionally grants Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins 40% DMG Bonus, up to 120%.
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with Tune Strain - Interfered, the stack count of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target is increased by 2. This effect ignores the max stack limit.
description.id:
Saat Resonator dalam tim di sekitar memberikan Tune Break DMG, semua bentuk Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Ichor Deposit, dan Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker memberikan 30% DMG lebih banyak kepada target selama 25 dtk.
Setiap stack Endnotes on the Endgame juga memberikan Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins 40% DMG Bonus, hingga 120%.
Saat Luuk Herssen memberikan damage kepada target yang terkena Tune Strain - Interfered, jumlah stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkat sebanyak 2. Efek ini mengabaikan batas stack maksimum.
